entries.30.1: जिते when conquered, महेन्द्रे Mahendra, अतिबले of great strength, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुतेन by the son, वै indeed, प्रजापतिम् Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य placing at their head, सुराः the gods, तदा then, लङ्काम् to Lanka, ययुः went
entries.30.2: तत्र there, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, पुत्रभ्रातृभिः by his sons and brothers, आवृतम् surrounded, गगने in the sky, तिष्ठन् standing, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, सामपूर्वम् with conciliatory words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.30.3: वत्स dear child, रावण Ravana, तव your, पुत्रस्य of the son, संयुगे in battle, तुष्टः pleased, अस्मि I am, अहो ah, अस्य his, विक्रमौदार्यम् valour and nobility, तव to you, तुल्यः equal, अधिकः greater, अपि वा or even
entries.30.4: भवता by you, स्वेन by your own, तेजसा energy, सर्वम् all, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, जितम् has been conquered, हि indeed, प्रतिज्ञा the vow, सफला fruitful, कृता has been made, स्वसुतेन with your own son, वै indeed, प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am
entries.30.5: रावण Ravana, अयम् this, तव your, पुत्रः son, अतिबलः exceedingly strong, वीर्यवान् valorous, जगति in the world, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, इत्येव by this very name, परिख्यातः renowned, भविष्यति will become
entries.30.6: बलवान् powerful, दुर्जयश्चैव and hard to conquer, राक्षसः the rakshasa, भविष्यत्येव will surely become, राजन् O king, यम् whom, समाश्रित्य relying upon, ते by you, त्रिदशाः the thirty gods, वशे under control, स्थापिताः have been placed
entries.30.7: तत् therefore, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, पाकशासनः the chastiser of Paka, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, मुच्यताम् let him be released, किञ्च and further, अस्य his, मोक्षणार्थाय for the sake of release, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven, प्रयच्छन्तु let them give
entries.30.8: अथ then, महातेजाः of great splendour, समितिञ्जयः victorious in battle, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, अब्रवीत् said, देव O god, यदि if, एषः he, मुच्यते is released, अहम् I, अमरत्वम् immortality, वृणे choose
entries.30.9: चतुष्पदाम् of the four-footed, खेचराणाम् of the sky-going, अन्येषाम् वा or of others, महौजसाम् of great might, वृक्षगुल्मक्षुपलतातृणोपलमहीभृताम् of trees and shrubs and bushes and creepers and grasses and stones and mountains
entries.30.10: सर्वे all, अपि even, जन्तवः living beings, अन्योन्यम् one another, भेतव्ये when there is cause for fear, सति being so, बिभ्यति are afraid, अतः therefore, अत्र here, लोके in the world, सर्वेषाम् for all, सर्वस्मात् from everything, भयम् fear, भवेत् would arise
entries.30.11: ततः then, महातेजाः of great splendour, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, मेघनादम् to Meghanada, अब्रवीत् said, भुवि on earth, कस्यचित् of any, प्राणिनः living being, सर्वामरत्वम् total immortality, नास्ति does not exist, हि indeed, चतुष्पदः the four-footed, पक्षिणश्च and the birds, भूतानाम् वा or of beings, महौजसाम् of great might
entries.30.12: इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, पितामहेन by the Grandsire, प्रभुणा by the lord, उक्तम् what was spoken, अव्ययम् imperishable, श्रुत्वा having heard
entries.30.13: अथ then, महाबलः of great strength, मेघनादः Meghanada, तत्रस्थम् him who stood there, अब्रवीत् addressed, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे in the release of Shatakratu, वा as to how, सिद्धिः fulfilment, भवेत् may come about
entries.30.14: मम by me, नित्यशः constantly, हव्यैः with oblations, मन्त्रैः with mantras, पावकम् the fire, सम्पूज्य having worshipped, इष्टम् has been sacrificed to, सङ्ग्रामम् into battle, अवतर्त्तुम् to descend, शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः of one desiring victory over foes
entries.30.15: विभावसोः from the fire, अश्वयुक्तः yoked with horses, रथः a chariot, मह्यम् for me, उत्तिष्ठेत् should arise, तत्स्थस्य of me standing in it, अमरता immortality, मे to me, स्यात् may be, एषः this, मे my, वरः boon, निश्चयः is the resolve
entries.30.16: तस्मिन् when that, जप्यहोमे muttered prayer and oblation, विभावसौ to the fire, असमाप्ते unfinished, यदि if, देव O god, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, युध्येयम् I should fight, तदा then, मे my, विनाशनम् destruction, स्यात् may come about
entries.30.17: देव O god, सर्वः every, पुमान् man, तपसा by austerity, हि indeed, अमरताम् immortality, वृणोति obtains, तु but, मया by me, विक्रमेण by valour, एतत् this, अमरत्वम् immortality, प्रवर्तितम् has been brought about
entries.30.18: देवः the god, पितामहः the Grandsire, तम् to him, एवमस्तु so be it, इति thus, वाक्यम् these words, आह said, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajit, शक्रः Shakra, मुक्तः was released, सुराः the gods, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, गताः went
entries.30.19: राम O Rama, एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, दीनः dejected, भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः his raiment and radiance fallen away, चिन्तापरीतात्मा his mind overcome by anxiety, इन्द्रः Indra, ध्यानतत्परताम् absorption in thought, गतः entered
entries.30.20: तथाभूतम् in such a state, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, देवः the god, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, प्राह said, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, पुरा formerly, किमु what, सुदुष्कृतम् grave misdeed, करोति स्म did you commit
entries.30.21: अमरेन्द्र O lord of the immortals, प्रभो O mighty one, मया by me, बह्व्यः many, प्रजाः creatures, तथा likewise, सृष्टाः were created, एकवर्णाः of one colour, समाभाषाः of like speech, एकरूपाः of one form, सर्वशः in every way
entries.30.22: तासाम् among them, दर्शने in appearance, लक्षणे in mark, अपि वा or even, विशेषः distinction, नास्ति there was none, हि indeed, ततः then, अहम् I, एकाग्रमनाः with concentrated mind, ताः those, प्रजाः creatures, परिचिन्तयम् pondered over
entries.30.23: सः that, अहम् I, तासाम् for them, विशेषार्थम् for the sake of distinction, एकाम् one, स्त्रियम् woman, विनिर्ममे fashioned, प्रजानाम् of the creatures, यद्यत् whatever, प्रत्यङ्गम् in each limb, विशिष्टम् was excellent, तत्तत् that and that, उद्धृतम् was drawn out
entries.30.24: ततः then, मया by me, रूपगुणैः with qualities of beauty, अहल्या Ahalya, स्त्री the woman, विनिर्मिता was fashioned, इह here, हलम् नाम what is called blemish, वैरूपम् is ugliness, तत्प्रभवम् arising from it, हल्यम् is the blemished, भवेत् would be
entries.30.25: यस्मात् since, हल्यम् blemish, न विद्यते does not exist in her, तेन therefore, अहल्या इति as Ahalya, विश्रुता she is known, शक्र O Shakra, मया by me, तस्याः her, नाम name, प्रवर्तितम् was thus established
entries.30.26: देवेन्द्र O lord of the gods, सुरर्षभ O bull among the gods, तस्याम् that, नार्याम् woman, निर्मितायाम् having been fashioned, एषा she, कस्य whose, भविष्यति shall be, इति thus, मम my, चिन्ता anxiety, ततः thereupon, अभवत् arose
entries.30.27: प्रभो O lord, पुरन्दर O Purandara, शक्र O Shakra, त्वम् you, तु however, तदा then, नारीम् the woman, मनसा in your mind, जानीषे marked out, स्थानाधिकतया by reason of superiority of station, एषा she, मम my, पत्नी wife, इति thus
entries.30.28: सा she, मया by me, न्यासभूता as a trust, महात्मनः of the great-souled, गौतमस्य Gautama, बहूनि for many, वर्षाणि years, न्यस्ता was placed, तेन by him, निर्यातिता was returned, च ह indeed
entries.30.29: ततः then, तस्य his, महामुनेः of the great sage, महास्थैर्यम् great steadfastness, परिज्ञाय having ascertained, तपसि in austerity, सिद्धिम् perfection, ज्ञात्वा having known, तदा then, पत्न्यर्थम् to be his wife, स्पर्शिता she was made over
entries.30.30: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, त्वम् you, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, हि indeed, मुनेः of the sage, तस्य his, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, गत्वा having gone, तदा then, अग्निशिखाम् इव like a flame of fire, दीप्ताम् blazing, ताम् that, स्त्रीम् woman, दृष्टवान् beheld
entries.30.31: शक्र O Shakra, कामार्तेन stricken with desire, समन्युना filled with passion, त्वया by you, सा she, धर्षिता was violated, तदा then, आश्रमे in the hermitage, परमर्षिणा by the supreme sage, तेन by him, त्वम् you, दृष्टः were seen
entries.30.32: ततः then, परमतेजसा of supreme splendour, क्रुद्धेन by the enraged one, तेन by him, शप्तः cursed, असि you were, देवेन्द्र O lord of the gods, येन whereby, दशाभागविपर्ययम् a reversal of a tenth part, गतः असि you have undergone
entries.30.33: वासव O Vasava, यस्मात् since, मे my, पत्नी wife, त्वया by you, निर्भयम् fearlessly, धर्षिता was violated, तस्मात् therefore, राजन् O king, त्वम् you, समरे in battle, शत्रुहस्तम् into the hand of the enemy, गमिष्यसि shall go
entries.30.34: दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, यः which, अयम् this, भावः practice, त्वया by you, इह here, प्रवर्तितः has been set going, मानुषेषु among human, लोकेषु worlds, अपि also, भविष्यति will arise, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.30.35: तत्र therein, यः he who, तस्य of it, कर्ता is the doer, अर्धम् half of it, त्वयि upon you, निपतिष्यति will fall, ते for you, स्थावरम् fixed, स्थानम् position, न भविष्यति will not remain, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.30.36: यश्च यश्च whoever, सुरेन्द्रः lord of the gods, स्यात् may be, सः he, ध्रुवः permanent, न भविष्यति will not be, मया by me, एषः this, शापः curse, मुक्तः has been released, इति thus, असौ he, तदा then, त्वाम् to you, अब्रवीत् said
entries.30.37: सः he, सुमहातपाः of very great austerity, ताम् that, भार्याम् wife, निर्भर्त्स्य having rebuked, अब्रवीत् said, दुर्विनीते O ill-behaved one, मम my, आश्रमसमीपतः from the neighbourhood of the hermitage, विनिध्वंस be gone
entries.30.38: यस्मात् since, रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना endowed with beauty and youth, त्वम् you, अनवस्थिता proved unsteady, तस्मात् therefore, लोके in the world, त्वम् you, एका alone, रूपवती beautiful, न भविष्यति shall not be
entries.30.39: ते your, रूपम् beauty, सर्वाः all, प्रजाः creatures, गमिष्यन्ति shall attain, न संशयः there is no doubt, यत् which, तत् that, एकम् alone, समाश्रित्य depending upon, अयम् this, विभ्रमः confusion, उपस्थितः has arisen
entries.30.40: तदाप्रभृति from that time onward, प्रजाः creatures, भूयिष्ठम् for the most part, रूपसमन्विताः endowed with beauty, सा she, तदा then, तम् that, महर्षिम् great sage, गौतमम् Gautama, प्रसादयामास sought to appease
entries.30.41: विप्र O brahmin, दिवौकसा by the dweller of heaven, त्वद्रूपेण in your form, अज्ञानात् through ignorance, धर्षिता I was violated, विप्रर्षे O sage among brahmins, न कामकारात् not through wilful desire, प्रसादम् favour, कर्तुम् to show, अर्हसि you ought
entries.30.42: अहल्यया by Ahalya, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सः he, गौतमः Gautama, प्रत्युवाच replied, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् among the Ikshvakus, महातेजाः of great splendour, महारथः a great chariot-warrior, उत्पत्स्यति will be born
entries.30.43: लोके in the world, रामो नाम Rama by name, श्रुतः renowned, ब्राह्मणार्थे for the sake of the brahmins, वनम् to the forest, चापि also, उपयास्यति will go, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, विष्णुः Vishnu, मानुषविग्रहः in human form, भद्रे O blessed lady, यदा when, तम् him, द्रक्ष्यसि you shall see, ततः then, पूता purified, भविष्यसि you shall become
entries.30.44: त्वया by you, यत् what, दुष्कृतम् misdeed, कृतम् was done, सः he, पावयितुम् to purify it, शक्तः is able, हि indeed, तस्य his, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृत्वा having offered, वै indeed, मत्समीपम् to my presence, गमिष्यसि you shall come
entries.30.45: वरवर्णिनि O lady of fair complexion, तदा then, हि indeed, त्वम् you, मया with me, सार्धम् together, वत्स्यसि shall dwell, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सः that, विप्रर्षिः sage among brahmins, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, आजगाम returned to
entries.30.46: ब्रह्मवादिनः of the expounder of the Veda, सा that, पत्नी wife, सुमहत् very great, तपः austerity, आचार practised, तस्य his, मुनेः of the sage, शापोत्सर्गात् from the utterance of the curse, हि indeed, इदम् this, सर्वम् all, उपस्थितम् has come about
entries.30.47: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, त्वया by you, यत् which, दुष्कृतम् misdeed, कृतम् was done, तत् that, त्वम् you, स्मर remember, वासव O Vasava, तेन through that, त्वम् you, शत्रोः of the enemy, ग्रहणम् into the grasp, यातः have gone, न अन्येन and not by any other cause
entries.30.48: त्वम् you, सुसमाहितः fully composed, शीघ्रम् swiftly, वैष्णवम् sacred to Vishnu, यज्ञम् sacrifice, यज perform, तेन by that, यज्ञेन sacrifice, पावितः purified, ततः then, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, यास्यसे you shall go
entries.30.49: देवेन्द्र O lord of the gods, तव your, पुत्रः son, महारणे in the great battle, न विनष्टः has not perished, आर्यकेण by his grandfather, महोदधौ in the great ocean, नीतः was carried away, सन्निहितश्चैव and kept in safety
entries.30.50: महेन्द्रः Mahendra, एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, वैष्णवम् Vaishnava, यज्ञम् sacrifice, इष्ट्वा having performed, देवराट् the king of the gods, पुनः again, त्रिदिवम् heaven, आक्रामत् ascended to, अन्वशासत् and ruled over it
entries.30.51: एतत् this, इन्द्रजितः of Indrajit, नाम indeed, बलम् strength, यत् which, मया by me, कीर्तितम् has been recounted, तेन by him, देवेन्द्रः the lord of the gods, निर्जितः was vanquished, अन्ये other, प्राणिनः living beings, तु then, किं पुनः what need be said of
entries.30.52: रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, तदा then, अगस्त्यवचनम् the words of Agastya, श्रुत्वा having heard, आश्चर्यम् a marvel, इति thus, अब्रवीत् exclaimed, वानराः the vanaras, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, तदा then
entries.30.53: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु however, रामस्य of Rama, पार्श्वस्थः standing at the side, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, आश्चर्यम् a marvel, यत् which, तत् that, पुरातनम् of old, दृष्टम् was seen, अद्य today, स्मारितः अस्मि I have been reminded of it
entries.30.54: रामः Rama, तु then, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, अब्रवीत् said, एतत् this, सत्यम् is true, मे by me, श्रुतम् has been heard
entries.30.55: राम O Rama, एवम् in this way, लोककण्टकः the thorn of the world, रावणः Ravana, समुद्भूतः arose, येन by whom, सपुत्रः along with his son, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, सुरेश्वरः the lord of the gods, शक्रः Shakra, जितः was conquered
entries.31.1: ततः then, महातेजाः of great splendour, रामः Rama, विस्मयात् out of wonder, पुनरेव once again, हि indeed, प्रणतः bowing low, ऋषिसत्तमम् the best of sages, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.31.2: भगवन् O venerable one, द्विजोत्तम O best of the twice-born, क्रूरः the cruel, राक्षसः rakshasa, यदाप्रभृति from the time when, मेदिनीम् the earth, पर्यटत् roamed over, तदा then, लोकाः the worlds, किम् whether, शून्याः empty, आसन् were
entries.31.3: तदा then, अत्र here, राजा a king, वा or, राजमात्रः one of kingly rank, कश्चन anyone, किम् न was there not, यत्र where, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, धर्षणम् a check, न प्राप्तः did not meet with
entries.31.4: उताहो or else, ते they, पृथिवीक्षितः the rulers of the earth, हतवीर्याः bereft of valour, बभूवुः became, वरास्त्रैः by his excellent weapons, बहिष्कृताः driven out, बहवः many, नृपाः kings, निर्जिताः were vanquished
entries.31.5: राघवस्य of Raghava, वचः the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, भगवान् the venerable, ऋषिः sage, अगस्त्यः Agastya, प्रहसन् smiling, पितामह इव like the Grandsire, ईश्वरम् to the lord, रामम् Rama, उवाच said
entries.31.6: पार्थिवर्षभ O bull among kings, पृथिवीपते O lord of the earth, राम O Rama, इत्येवम् in this very manner, पार्थिवान् the kings, बाधमानः harassing, तु indeed, रावणः Ravana, पृथिवीम् over the earth, चचार roamed
entries.31.7: ततः then, स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम् splendid as the city of heaven, माहिष्मतीं नाम Mahishmati by name, पुरीम् the city, सम्प्राप्तः he reached, यत्र where, वसुरेतसः of Agni, सान्निध्यम् the presence, सदा always, आसीत् was
entries.31.8: तस्य of that city, वसुरेतसः of Agni, प्रभावात् by the power, तुल्यः his equal, नृपः a king, आसीत् there was, अर्जुनो नाम Arjuna by name, यत्र where, अग्निः the fire, सदा ever, शरकुण्डेशयः lay in a pit of reeds
entries.31.9: सः he, अथ then, बली the mighty, ईश्वरः lord, हैहयाधिपतिः chief of the Haihayas, अर्जुनः Arjuna, स्त्रीभिः सह with his women, रन्तुम् to sport, नर्मदाम् to the Narmada, गतः had gone, तमेव दिवसम् on that very day
entries.31.10: तमेव दिवसम् on that very day, सः he, अथ then, रावणः Ravana, तत्र there, आगतः arrived, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, तु then, तस्य his, अमात्यान् ministers, अपृच्छत questioned
entries.31.11: अर्जुनः Arjuna, नृपतिः the king, क्व where is he, शीघ्रम् quickly, सम्यक् rightly, आख्यातुम् to tell, अर्हथ you ought, अहम् I, रावणः Ravana, नृवरेण with the best of men, युद्धेप्सुः desiring battle, अनुप्राप्तः have arrived, मम my, आगमनम् arrival, अपि also, अग्रे beforehand, युष्माभिः by you, सन्निवेद्यताम् let it be announced
entries.31.12: इत्येवम् in this manner, रावणेन by Ravana, उक्ताः addressed, ते those, सुविपश्चितः very wise, अमात्याः ministers, राक्षसपतिम् to the lord of the rakshasas, महीपतेः of the king, असान्निध्यम् the absence, अब्रुवन् reported
entries.31.13: विश्रवसः of Vishravas, पुत्रः the son, पौराणाम् from the citizens, अर्जुनम् that Arjuna, गतम् had gone away, श्रुत्वा having heard, अपसृत्य having withdrawn, हिमवत्सन्निभम् resembling Himavat, गिरिम् the mountain, विन्ध्यम् Vindhya, आगतः came to
entries.31.14: सः he, रावणः Ravana, अभ्रम् इव like a cloud, आविष्टम् spread abroad, मेदिनीम् the earth, उद्भ्रान्तम् इव as if heaving it up, अम्बरम् the sky, आलिखन्तम् इव as if scoring it, तम् that, विन्ध्यम् Vindhya, अपश्यत् beheld
entries.31.15: सहस्रशिखरोपेतम् possessed of a thousand peaks, सिंहाध्युषितकन्दरम् its caves inhabited by lions, प्रपातपतितैः falling in cascades, तोयैः with waters, साट्टहासम् इव as if laughing aloud, अम्बुधिम् like the ocean
entries.31.16: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः with gods and danavas and gandharvas, साप्सरोगणकिन्नरैः with hosts of apsaras and kinnaras, स्वस्त्रीभिः with their own women, क्रीडमानैः sporting, स्वर्गभूतम् become like heaven itself, महोच्छ्रयम् of great height
entries.31.17: स्यन्दमानाभिः with flowing, नदीभिः rivers, स्फटिकप्रतिमम् like crystal, जलम् water, चलजिह्वाभिः with quivering tongues, फणाभिः with hoods, अनन्तम् इव like Ananta, विष्ठितम् spread out
entries.31.18: उत्क्रामन्तम् towering upward, दरीवन्तम् full of caverns, हिमवत्सन्निभम् resembling Himavat, गिरिम् the mountain, विन्ध्यम् the Vindhya, पश्यमानः gazing upon, ततः then, रावणः Ravana, नर्मदाम् to the Narmada, ययौ went
entries.31.19: चलोपलजलाम् her waters rippling over stones, पुण्याम् holy, पश्चिमोदधिगामिनीम् flowing to the western ocean
entries.31.20: उष्णाभितप्तैः scorched by the heat, तृषितैः thirsty, महिषैः by buffaloes, सृमरैः by deer, सिंहैः by lions, शार्दूलर्क्षगजोत्तमैः by tigers and bears and lordly elephants, सङ्क्षोभितजलाशयाम् her pools all stirred up
entries.31.21: चक्रवाकैः with chakravaka birds, सकारण्डैः with karandava ducks, सहंसजलकुक्कुटैः with swans and water-fowl, सदा ever, मत्तैः exhilarated, सुकूजद्भिः sweetly calling, सारसैः with cranes, समावृताम् thronged
entries.31.22: फुल्लद्रुमकृतोत्तंसाम् wearing blossoming trees for her crest, चक्रवाकयुगस्तनीम् a pair of chakravakas for her breasts, विस्तीर्णपुलिनश्रोणीम् broad sandbanks for her hips, हंसावलिसुमेखलाम् a line of swans for her lovely girdle
entries.31.23: पुष्परेण्वनुलिप्ताङ्गीम् her limbs smeared with flower pollen, जलफेनामलांशुकाम् the foam of the water for her spotless garment, जलावगाहसंस्पर्शाम् her touch that of a plunge into water, फुल्लोत्पलशुभेक्षणाम् open lotuses for her lovely eyes, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka, आशु swiftly, अवरुह्य having descended, सरिताम् among rivers, वराम् the best, नर्मदाम् the Narmada
entries.31.24: दशाननः the ten-faced one, इष्टाम् वराम् नारीम् इव as though a beloved and lovely woman, अवगाह्य having plunged into her, सः he, तस्याः her, रम्ये on the delightful, नानामुनिनिषेविते frequented by many sages, पुलिने sandbank
entries.31.25: उपोपविष्टैः seated close about him, सचिवैः सार्धम् together with his ministers, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the bull among rakshasas, सः he, अथ then, रावणः Ravana, नर्मदाम् the Narmada, गङ्गा इयम् इति as this Ganga, प्रख्याय having proclaimed
entries.31.26: राक्षसाधिपः the lord of the rakshasas, नर्मदादर्शजम् born of the sight of the Narmada, हर्षम् delight, आप्तवान् obtained, तत्र there, सलीलम् playfully, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, सचिवान् his ministers, उवाच addressed
entries.31.27: एषः this, सूर्यः sun, रश्मिसहस्रेण with his thousand rays, जगत् the world, काञ्चनम् golden, कृत्वैव having verily made, तीक्ष्णतापकरः maker of fierce heat, नभसः of the sky, अर्धम् the midpoint, समाश्रितः has reached
entries.31.28: दिवाकरः the day-maker, माम् me, आसीनम् seated here, विदित्वैव knowing indeed, चन्द्रायति behaves like the moon
entries.31.29: नर्मदाजलशीतः cooled by the water of the Narmada, सुगन्धिः fragrant, श्रमनाशनः dispelling fatigue, अत्र here, अनिलः the wind, अपि even, मद्भयात् from fear of me, सुसमाहितः well restrained, वात्येष blows thus
entries.31.30: इयम् this, वापि moreover, सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा best of rivers, नर्मदा Narmada, नर्मवर्धिनी increaser of delight, नक्रमीनविहङ्गोर्मिः her waves bearing crocodiles and fish and birds, सभया इव as if timid, अङ्गना a woman, स्थिता stands
entries.31.31: तत् therefore, भवन्तः you, इन्द्रसमैः equal to Indra, नृपैः by kings, युधि in battle, शस्त्रैः with weapons, क्षताः wounded, चन्दनस्य of sandal, रसेन इव as with the paste, रुधिरेण with blood, समुक्षिताः besprinkled
entries.31.32: ते those, यूयम् you, शर्मदाम् bestower of comfort, शुभाम् auspicious, नर्मदाम् the Narmada, अवगाहध्वम् plunge into, महापद्ममुखाः headed by Mahapadma, मत्ताः rutting, गहागजाः mighty elephants, गङ्गाम् इव as into the Ganga, अस्याम् in this, महानद्याम् great river, स्नात्वा having bathed, पाप्मानम् sin, विप्रमोक्ष्यथ you shall cast off
entries.31.33: अहम् I, अपि also, अद्य today, शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे radiant as the autumn moon, पुलिने on the sandbank, शनकैः unhurriedly, कपर्दिनः to the matted-haired lord, पुष्पोपहारम् an offering of flowers, करिष्यामि shall make
entries.31.34: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् thus, उक्ताः addressed, प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः Prahasta and Shuka and Sarana, समहोदरधूम्राक्षाः along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, नर्मदाम् into the Narmada, विजगाहिरे plunged
entries.31.35: तैः by those, राक्षसेन्द्रगजैः elephants among the lords of the rakshasas, नर्मदा the Narmada, नदी river, क्षोभिता was churned up, वामनाञ्जनपद्माद्यैः by Vamana and Anjana and Padma and the rest, महागजैः by the great elephants, गङ्गा इव as the Ganga is
entries.31.36: ततः then, ते those, महाबलाः mighty, राक्षसाः rakshasas, नर्मदायाम् in the Narmada, स्नात्वा having bathed, उत्तीर्य having come up, रावणस्य of Ravana, बल्यर्थम् for the offering, पुष्पाणि flowers, आजह्रुः brought
entries.31.37: शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे gleaming like a white cloud, हृद्ये delightful, नर्मदापुलिने on the sandbank of the Narmada, राक्षसैः by the rakshasas, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, पुष्पमयः made of flowers, गिरिः a mountain, कृतः was raised
entries.31.38: एवम् thus, पुष्पेषु the flowers, उपहृतेषु having been brought, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, महागजः इव like a great elephant, स्नातुम् to bathe, नदीम् into the river, अवतीर्णः went down
entries.31.39: तत्र there, विधिवत् according to rule, स्नात्वा having bathed, अनुत्तमम् most excellent, जप्यम् the prayer, जप्त्वा having muttered, सः that, रावणः Ravana, तस्मात् from that, नर्मदासलिलात् water of the Narmada, उत्ततार came up
entries.31.40: ततः then, क्लिन्नाम्बरम् his wet garment, त्यक्त्वा having cast off, शुक्लवस्त्रसमावृतम् clad in white cloth, प्राञ्जलिम् with joined palms, यान्तम् walking on, रावणम् Ravana, सर्वराक्षसाः all the rakshasas, अन्वयुः followed
entries.31.41: तद्गतीवशम् आपन्नाः moving as he moved, मूर्तिमन्तः embodied, अचलाः इव like mountains, यत्र यत्र wherever, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, याति स्म went, तत्र तत्र there too, जाम्बूनदमयम् made of gold, लिङ्गम् the linga, नीयते स्म was carried
entries.31.42: रावणः Ravana, वालुकावेदिमध्ये in the midst of an altar of sand, तत् that, लिङ्गम् linga, स्थाप्य having installed, गन्धैः with fragrances, अमृतगन्धिभिः of nectar-like scent, पुष्पैश्च and with flowers, अर्चयामास worshipped it
entries.31.43: ततः then, सः he, निशाचरः the night-ranger, सताम् of the good, आर्तिहरम् remover of distress, परम् the supreme, वरम् the excellent, वरप्रदम् granter of boons, चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम् adorned with the rays of the moon, समर्चयित्वा having worshipped, जगौ sang, हस्तान् his arms, प्रसार्य stretching out, अग्रतः before him, प्रणनर्त danced
